description: This file defines API routes for managing 'scenarios' in a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, retrieving by ID, and updating scenarios, utilizing schemas and a service layer.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance for defining API endpoints related to scenarios.

methods.name: _get_service
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of ScenariosService, raises RuntimeError if not initialized.

methods.name: set_scenarios_service
methods.description: Sets the singleton ScenariosService used by the router.

methods.name: list_scenarios
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all scenarios.

methods.name: create_scenario
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new scenario.

methods.name: get_scenario
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a scenario by its UUID.

methods.name: patch_scenario
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update (patch) a scenario by its UUID.
